general_faq.problem: How to power on/power off the machine
general_faq.solution:
1. After connecting the treadmill to the power supply, you need to turn on the switch button next to the power cord at the bottom of the machine head to start it. Once it's turned on, insert the safety lock. Shortly press the central function button in the middle of the electronic display. After a 3-second countdown, the treadmill will slowly start. During exercise, short press the central function button, and the treadmill will slowly stop and enter a pause state
2. When starting the treadmill, use the round button in the middle of the remote control to start and pause, and adjust speed by pressing the up or down button. The bottom button on the remote control is the mode switch button. Short press will switch between exercise modes, while long press will put the machine into standby mode.

general_faq.problem: The tail of the new machine is tilted up
Walking belt/running belt interface/walking belt crease
general_faq.solution:
1. All machines will have a bevel edge/interface, which is a normal process for treadmills/running machines. It is a normal phenomenon. Currently, all machines on the market have this interface, so you can use them normally.
2. The running belt is formed into a closed structure by pressing the entire track, resulting in belt joints. The sawtooth-shaped hot pressing joint process is adopted at the joints, significantly enhancing the tensile strength and ensuring durability.
3. The crease on the walking belt is inevitably caused by the machine's storage and folding process; it does not affect the machine's function and use, and no special treatment is required, so there is no need to worry; as the machine is unfolded and used, the crease will gradually fade under the tension of the roller

general_faq.problem: Does the new machine need to be added with silicone oil
general_faq.solution:
The new machine does not require adjustment of the running belt upon receipt. If you notice any lateral deviation of the running belt, simply center it manually and restart the machine. Do not make any adjustments, as this may damage the machine's running belt.
There is no need to refuel the new machine immediately after receiving it. Depending on the frequency and duration of use, it is recommended to refuel after 1-3 months of use, with about 5-8ml added each time.

general_faq.problem: The machine emits an unusual odor or smoke
general_faq.solution:
1. Smell upon receipt: Due to the closed storage in the factory warehouse, there may be a slight odor caused by environmental factors. Please place it in a well-ventilated area and use it with confidence. The odor will dissipate after a few days.
2. Unusual odor during operation: 1. The odor is caused by the friction between the running belt and the sole of the foot, generating heat. Please rest assured to use it, and please wear sneakers when using the machine.
3. If the machine head emits a burnt smell, smoke, or sparks, please immediately stop using the machine and open the machine head for troubleshooting and repair; (specific troubleshooting involves dismantling the machine, opening the machine head to check for the ignition point, identifying the specific component, and replacing it for repair)

general_faq.problem: Machine jerking and the high gear is slow
Suggestions on machine usage frequency
general_faq.solution:
1. Refer to the testing standard for household treadmills (EN957-6: H-grade withstands 12,000 impacts, which is converted to a continuous 300-hour fatigue test); it is recommended that household treadmills be used 3-5 times per week, with each use not exceeding 1 hour; usage frequency is a key factor affecting the lifespan of the treadmill. High-intensity daily use will accelerate wear and tear;
2. Maintenance is crucial to the lifespan of a treadmill. Regularly clean the running belt and the machine body to prevent dust accumulation. Check the tightness of the running belt every 3 months and adjust it if necessary. Lubricating the running belt is an important step to extend its lifespan. It is recommended to use specialized lubricant for lubrication every 6 months to reduce friction and wear;

After you use it for a while, the belt will gradually become softer, and the sound will gradually decrease and disappear

general_faq.problem: Walking belt/running belt friction noise
general_faq.solution: 1. The track has deviated to the left or right, and one side has rubbed against the frame. At this time, it is necessary to use an L-shaped wrench to adjust the walking belt. 2. Measures: If a pad is used, adjust the middle foot pad up by 1-2 turns to compensate for the deformation of the pad;

general_faq.problem: The machine is prone to static electricity
general_faq.solution:
① Eliminate the possibility of machine leakage
All our products undergo four safety inspections stipulated by the state before leaving the factory, eliminating potential electrical leakage hazards from the source. If the machine has an electrical leakage issue, touching the corresponding part will continuously generate inductance; however, occasional inductance is a normal phenomenon caused by the release of accumulated static electricity from the human body through the treadmill.
② Principle of static electricity generation
During human movement, frequent friction occurs between clothing items, generating static electricity that adheres to them. Even without touching the treadmill, subsequent contact with grounded metal objects such as door handles can result in electrostatic discharge.
③ Small suggestions to reduce static electricity accumulation
1. Mail the electrostatic wristband + electrostatic patch to release static electricity + prevent direct contact with the machine. (Users have reported static electricity in 1-2 locations.)
2. Send an electrostatic wristband by mail + offer a certain price difference discount, encouraging users to purchase a humidifier to maintain indoor humidity at 40%–60% (users have reported static electricity issues in multiple locations)
3. Avoid wearing clothes made of synthetic fibers, polyester, nylon, and other similar materials during exercise, as these fabrics are prone to generating static electricity when rubbed. It is recommended to choose natural and breathable fabrics such as pure cotton, linen, and bamboo fiber. Clothing should be as light and loose as possible to reduce the generation of static electricity from the sourc

When we move, the friction between clothes, and the friction between the sole of our shoes and the running track, can generate static electricity on our bodies. Essentially, when objects come into contact and rub against each other, charges are transferred to insulators, such as certain clothes we wear. These charges cannot be released due to the properties of the insulators, and gradually accumulate on the surface of the objects. Once these charged insulators come into contact with conductors, such as metal surfaces or human bodies, the charges find an outlet to vent, eagerly transferring. Accompanied by a crisp "snap", the discharge phenomenon is complete. This is the basic principle of static electricity formation.

items.question: 1. After using it for a period of time, the user found that the resistance value of the gas spring has slightly decreased:
items.answer:
Dear customer:
If you notice a slight decrease in the gas springs' resistance value, this is a common physical phenomenon that indicates the gas springs have entered a more stable working state. This will not affect your daily use for your training or product life span. For future use, we recommend placing the product in a dry environment away from direct sunlight.

items.question: 2. After using for a period of time, the user found that the gas spring was malfunctioning or jammed:
items.answer: Gas springs are consumables and will age naturally with use and training intensity. When they become noticeably sticky or lose resistance, we will assist you in replacing them. To ensure timely use, please refer to the gas spring replacement video for instructions.

items.question: 3. Reply to questions related to the lifespan of gas springs:
items.answer:
Dear customer:
Our gas springs comes with a one-year warranty, and it use thickened steel tubing for the body, and the piston rod is chrome-plated for rust and wear resistance. We have also conducted durability tests under normal household conditions. It can be used normally for more than 5 years by people who use it frequently with a high level of resistance; for normal users, it can last for more than 8 years. 
For future use, we recommend placing the product in a dry environment away from direct sunlight, wiping the gas spring's piston rod (metal part) and cylinder surface with a dry cloth to remove dust and sweat.

3. There are problems with the chain: too long/too short, lack of oil or getting stuck, all of which can affect the strength of the bike. Adjust it to the appropriate length and remember to refuel regularly.
4. Transmission not adjusted properly: Failure to calibrate properly can cause the chain and gears to not match, making cycling more laborious. Just check the position of the transmission and readjust it.
5. The crankshaft and central axis are loose: The connecting screws are loose and the power cannot be transmitted. Just tighten the relevant screws.
